dedupe_keys.name: python package to optimize wastewater treatment plants

description: Vânia Miguel and Isabel Espírito Santo publish a Python optimisation package for wastewater-treatment plants. Zenodo archives version 1.0 under CC BY 4.0 and links a public repository. The README describes a single-objective Hybrid Genetic Pattern Search Augmented Lagrangian algorithm and a multi-objective Elitist Genetic Algorithm. They search a BSM1-based treatment model with 115 decision variables for lower total cost and improved effluent quality; example notebooks and requirements are provided. The package can test operational choices and cost-quality trade-offs in treatment simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this pair of algorithms. Coverage is the benchmark plant model, not a verified optimisation of a named live facility. A limitation is that the GitHub README says CC BY-SA 4.0 while Zenodo metadata says CC BY 4.0, so intended reuse terms need clarification. The algorithms were not installed or run, and the stated benchmark improvement was not reproduced.
